prompts.title: D · 街头火花
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: a bold original character design turnaround for a strength-training app, an exploratory character selection sheet before image-to-3D and humanoid rigging.
Create a NEW design with strong personality. This must feel like an authored character from a distinctive original world, not a stock fitness model, not an anatomy mannequin, not a generic handsome athlete, not a white clay render.
Composition: landscape, three full-body orthographic views of the EXACT SAME character, FRONT / RIGHT SIDE facing right / BACK, from left to right. Match all costume details, proportions, pose, scale and baseline. Comfortable margins, entire head and feet included. True profile in the middle. No extra poses or inset heads. Neutral relaxed A-pose with straight arms angled 30 degrees away from torso, legs hip-width apart, hands with five clear fingers. Consistent head, shoulder, pelvis and knee heights across all views.
Style: exceptionally polished stylized 3D character concept art, beautifully resolved silhouettes, simple broad material/color areas, original shapes that will translate well to a 3D mesh. Continuous organic limbs, recognizable shoulder/elbow/wrist/hip/knee/ankle articulation, visible athletic anatomical volumes beneath close-fitting clothing. Appropriate for adult fitness users. Characterful expression while holding a neutral modeling pose.
Soft neutral studio light, clean pale warm-gray backdrop, light contact shadow only. Full color with designed materials. No equipment, weights, props in hands, base pedestal, loose straps, dangling accessories, logos or watermarks. No branded character resemblance. No muscle activation paint in this concept stage. Text only the specified small heading at top left and view labels under each figure.
This sheet is for choosing character identity and art direction, not a medical anatomical reference.
Character: a rebellious but welcoming adult male street-sport athlete, about 26, with medium-deep warm brown skin, compact springy athletic build, a strong torso and muscular legs, approximately 6.5 heads tall. A striking sculpted magenta short mohawk with shaved sides, broad dark expressive eyebrows with a single notch, slightly crooked confident grin and one raised eyebrow. Exaggerate facial shapes with intention: a broad flat nose, angular cheeks, a strong but not square jaw, and clear lively eyes. Smooth stylized shading, no photographic skin.
Costume: fitted sleeveless dark olive training singlet exposing shoulders and arms, burnt-orange fitted upper-thigh shorts with a bold off-center lilac side panel, tall cream socks with one wide magenta stripe, chunky cream-and-dark-olive training shoes. Keep shorts close to leg so the pelvis and quadriceps silhouette stays readable. Small integrated color blocks rather than logos or printed graffiti. All clothing looks sporty and functional.
Personality and design: energetic indie street-sport game protagonist, confident, mischievous, distinctive in silhouette even as a thumbnail. Broad shoulders, slightly oversized hands and sneakers, elastic-looking but credible joint transitions. Avoid military/tactical clothing and avoid realistic celebrity looks.
Text verbatim: "D / STREET SPARK", "FRONT", "SIDE", "BACK".
